title: StabQ: Quantum Program Analysis via Weighted Stabilizer Representations
summary: Quantum program analysis remains challenging due to the exponentially large state space of quantum programs and the difficulty of precisely characterizing their execution behavior. In particular, non-Clifford operations introduce additional complexity that limits the applicability of stabilizer-based techniques. Although stabilizer representations provide compact descriptions for Clifford circuits, their limited expressiveness prevents them from directly supporting general quantum program analysis. In this work, we propose StabQ, a symbolic execution framework for quantum program analysis…
